analysis.title: Qualcomm Inc. (QCOM): First Take: In-line quarter with better revenue guidance, but weaker margins
key_insights: GS expects QCOM to trade modestly lower after an in-line FY4Q26 print with weaker margin guidance.
Handset revenue stayed weak at $5.1 bn, below GS and the Street at $5.2 bn. Automotive ($1.99 bn) and IoT ($1.89 bn) beat both GS and the Street.
Datacenter revenue begins an initial ramp in the December quarter.
Gross margin of 52.4% missed GS at 53.5% and the Street at 53.3%. EBT margin of 25.5% missed GS at 26.2% and the Street at 26.3%.
FY1Q27 revenue guidance of $10.8 bn is in line with GS at $10.8 bn and above the Street at $10.5 bn. EPS (excl. SBC) guidance of $2.25 is below GS at $2.41 and the Street at $2.33.
GS expects the call to focus on Android smartphone recovery visibility, the shape of the FY27 datacenter revenue ramp, and progress on diversification.
GS rates QCOM Neutral with a 12-month target of $160, based on 14X P/E on normalized EPS of $11.50. The target implies 2.7% downside from $164.43.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral and $160 target kept, based on 14X P/E on normalized EPS of $11.50. Stock is expected to trade modestly lower on weaker margin guidance.

earnings_insights: FY4Q26 reported revenue $10.3 bn in the text summary (Exhibit 1 shows $10,442 mn) vs GS $10.2 bn and Street $10.2 bn, reported in line.
FY4Q26 reported gross margin (excl. SBC) 52.4% vs GS 53.5% and Street 53.3%. Reported EBT margin 25.5% vs GS 26.2% and Street 26.3%.
FY4Q26 reported operating EPS (excl. SBC) $2.17 vs GS estimate $2.16 and Street estimate $2.17.
FY4Q26 reported QCT revenue $9.02 bn vs GS and Street estimate $8.78 bn. Handsets $5.1 bn vs estimate $5.2 bn. Automotive $1.99 bn vs estimate $1.7 bn. IoT $1.89 bn vs estimate $1.8 bn.

FY1Q27 company guidance: revenue $10.8 bn (GS estimate $10.8 bn, Street estimate $10.5 bn), EPS excl. SBC $2.25 (GS estimate $2.41, Street estimate $2.33). Exhibit 2 shows QCT guidance of $9,300 mn and QTL of $1,400 mn.
Exhibit 1 total revenue is -7.3% YoY and +5.0% QoQ. Exhibit 2 guidance implies -11.9% YoY and +3.4% QoQ.
GS EPS estimates: FY26E $10.52, FY27E $11.10, FY28E $13.80. Quarterly: 12/26E $2.41, 3/27E $2.59.
risk_factors: Upside risks: stronger traction for Qualcomm's Datacenter CPUs, stabilizing share or share gains in smartphones, stronger traction for ARM-based PCs.
Downside risks: greater share loss in smartphones, slower automotive and IoT revenue ramp.
